#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int f(string x, string y) {
    int m = x.size();
    int n = y.size();
    vector<vector<int>> v(m + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++){
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++){
            if (x[i-1] == y[j-1]){
                v[i][j] = v[i-1][j-1] + 1;
            } else {
                v[i][j] = max(v[i-1][j], v[i][j-1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return v[m][n];
}

bool g(string x, string y) {
    if(x.size() != y.size()){
        return false;
    }
    return f(x + x, y) == y.size();
}

int main() {
    string x, y;
    cin >> x >> y;
    cout << g(x, y) << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int solve1(int n) {
    return n * n;
}

int solve2(int n) {
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            if (n / i == i) {
                sum += i * i;
            } else {
                sum += i * i + (n / i) * (n / i);
            }
        }
    }
    return sum;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve2(solve1(n)) << " " << solve1(solve2(n)) << endl;
    return 0;
}
